textures.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: actual flat game texture PNG for a hand-painted 3D quarter-view environment.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED environment concept, used to derive surface art and its hand-painted style. User wants texture artwork that is literally put on 3D meshes, not procedural reinterpretation.
Create a NEW FLAT TEXTURE ARTWORK of the specified surface inspired by this concept. Remove the scene camera perspective, objects and scene lighting. Match the approved Hearthstone / Warcraft / Blizzard / League of Legends hand-painted stylization: bold broad opaque brush strokes, large readable color planes, creamy painted edge light, soft purple colored shadows, controlled few painterly nicks, clear whimsical chunky shape design. No realistic scratches or grunge, no photographic metal, no PBR render.
Fill the entire image edge to edge with the texture; strictly flat orthographic surface art. No 3D scene, no perspective, no diorama, no drop shadow outside the artwork, no sample swatches, no text, no watermark. No UI, no characters. All detail must be part of the actual painted surface. Favor broad quiet planes and intentional authored brushwork over dense noise.
Surface: one COMPLETE 8m-wide by 6m-deep rectangular workshop floor plan, top-down, 4:3 landscape image. Top edge = rear wall at the workbench, bottom edge = open front machinery lip. Strictly rectangular orthographic shape fills canvas. Arrange four equal-width columns and three equal-height rows of 2m plate panels; seam lines MUST be exactly at x=25%,50%,75% and y=33.333%,66.667%, and each panel has broad lavender/periwinkle brush shading with a subtle hand-painted bevel line, softly clipped painted corners. Base is muted lavender-blue as the approved image, not charcoal. Top row has a buttery cream service pad along the back edge, fading/stepping into lavender by the first row seam. Broad cream framing lane around the left/right and bottom perimeter, controlled coral angled corner brackets at only a few corners. A single low-contrast coral rectangular maintenance hatch centered horizontally in the lower-middle floor area, with a narrow sage rim. Open central half is calm lavender with sweeping lilac brush strokes, no props, no tools, no tanks, no furniture, no railings, no stairs, no cast shadows, no giant hazard stripes. Painted surface shading only. Subtle depth painting at joints but not black lines. Preserve the approved soft warm-cream vs cool-lilac balance. No drainage grilles except one very simple small grouped inset-slot area at the outer right edge. This is a single room-specific albedo artwork, not a repeated checker texture.
